result.instructions: Tools for Vatstack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is the VAT number DE123456789 valid, and which company does it belong to?"; "Which VAT rate applies to ebooks in France right now?"; "How many validations have we used this month, and how many does our plan include?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vatstack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vatstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vatstack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vatstack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vatstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vatstack_validate_vat
tools.title: Validate a VAT number
tools.description: Check a VAT number against the official government register. Returns whether the company is active and VAT-registered, with its name and address when the register gives them. Each check creates a validation record and uses one hit of the plan. Vatstack: POST /v1/validations.

vat_number.description: VAT number with its country prefix, for example DE123456789.

type.description: Limit the check to one region. Omit it to detect the type from the number.

tools.name: vatstack_list_validations
tools.title: List VAT validations
tools.description: List past VAT number validations, newest first. Filter by batch, number, type or request date range. Vatstack: GET /v1/validations.

query.description: Only validations for this VAT number.

type.description: Only validations of this region type.

batch.description: Only validations in this batch id.

requested_since.description: Only validations requested on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

requested_until.description: Only validations requested on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: vatstack_get_validation
tools.title: Get a VAT validation
tools.description: Get one VAT validation by its id, with the register result and any error code. Vatstack: GET /v1/validations/{id}.

validation_id.description: Validation id (a UUID) from a validation or a list call.

tools.name: vatstack_get_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: List standard and reduced VAT rates by country, including rates for digital products. Filter by a two-letter country code or EU member state. Vatstack: GET /v1/rates.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example DE.

tools.name: vatstack_get_rate_by_ip
tools.title: Get the VAT rate for an IP address
tools.description: Get the VAT rate that applies to an IPv4 or IPv6 address, from its geolocated country. Leave the address empty to use the requesting address. Vatstack: GET /v1/rates/geolocate.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to geolocate.

annotations.title: Get the VAT rate for an IP address

tools.name: vatstack_get_hits
tools.title: Get plan hit usage
tools.description: Get the hits used this month and the plan capacity, for supplies and validations. Check it before a batch of validations. Vatstack: GET /v1/hits.
